answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 2179 Country: Bangladesh Title: Nowadays we can store The complete Al-Quran in our Computers or even in our mobile sets.Can we take the mobile set to toilet which contains Al-Quran. Can we touch the screen of computer or mobile set without Uju while displaying Al-Quran. Question: Nowadays we can store The complete Al-Quran in our Computers or even in our mobile sets.Can we take the mobile set to toilet which contains Al-Quran. Can we touch the screen of computer or mobile set without Uju while displaying Al-Quran. Answer ID: 2179 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1029/1029=J) It is generally not possible to avoid disrespect and desecration after storing the Quran in a mobile set; therefore it should not be stored in mobile. Yes, it can be stored in computer, but when it will appear at the screen, the screen will be considered as pages of the Quran and it will not be allowed to touch it without wuzu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
